preconditions.description: The root of the tree is either a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.description: The return value is either a TreeNode or None, representing the head of the doubly linked list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in dll_nodes) and all(node.left is None and node.right is None for node in dll_nodes)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the doubly linked list are leaf nodes of the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None and node.right is None for node in tree_nodes) or node is None for node in tree_nodes
postconditions.description: All remaining nodes in the tree are non-leaf nodes or the tree is empty.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left in tree_nodes for node in tree_nodes) and all(node.right is None or node.right in tree_nodes for node in tree_nodes)
postconditions.description: All child pointers in the tree point to nodes within the modified tree or are None.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left in dll_nodes for node in dll_nodes) and all(node.right is None or node.right in dll_nodes for node in dll_nodes)
postconditions.description: All child pointers in the doubly linked list point to nodes within the DLL or are None.
